content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Walton Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours-of-experience thresholds for the PMP credential. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our instructors deliver the required formal education over a structured schedule you can fit around your Fort Walton Beach–area job. Attend all sessions to receive your course completion certificate.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your official PMP application to PMI. Include your course-completion certificate, project-experience documentation, and proof of education. Pay the PMI exam fee when you apply. PMI will review and approve your eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides, to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam through PMI's testing partner. You may test at an authorized center or remotely. Pass the exam to earn your PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by completing PMI-approved training, volunteering, or publishing work in project management. Submit your PDU hours to PMI before your expiration date to keep your credential active.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
